purpose: Accumulate current evidence prospectively so future RK-MIS validation does not depend on sparse retrospective reconstruction.

smart_money.authorized_structured_source: Upstox Company Fundamentals Share Holdings API
smart_money.capture_rule: Journal only the latest currently observable reporting quarter from each current provider response. Do not backfill older history returned in the same response as if RK-MIS had observed it at the historical date.
smart_money.known_at_rule: Use the RK-MIS capture date; later revisions replace a period only for as-of dates at or after the later observation.
smart_money.feature_release_rule: A 4Q change requires five point-in-time observed periods spanning 330-400 days. Missing component values are not imputed.

documentary_discovery.rule: Only chronology-safe reviewed evidence may fill approved feature fields. Automated candidates are not scores until the review gate approves them.

global_rules: No provider category relabelling merely to improve coverage.
No score-band or pillar-weight change from prospective tracking itself.
Future return testing must be preregistered before outcome load.
Management promise delivery remains unavailable until at least three closed reviewed promises.
